81:t_1:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh no! That makes today's pay 70 yen!」

81:t_1:87.en:
$$店長$$
「Every single day you break plates, you break frying pans, and last week, you finally went and broke a refrigerator... Nobody breaks a refrigerator, normally.」

81:t_1:88.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Breaking things is the only thing I'm good at.」

81:t_1:89.en:
$$店長$$
「Want to go back to the country and split firewood or something?」

81:t_1:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can't be that cut-and-dried about it... ...Besides... I don't even know what's become of my hometown...」

81:t_1:91.en:
$$店長$$
「...True. I never imagined my shop on Mars would get warped to Earth, either.」

81:t_1:92.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But no matter how tough things get, $$ノノ$$ will overcome it! With hard work and guts...!」

81:t_1:93.en:
$$店長$$
「...$$ノノ$$, you're still young, so you might not get it, but...」

81:t_1:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Um... are commercial refrigerators, like, expensive?」

81:t_1:95.en:
$$店長$$
「Of course they are. $$ノノ$$, after this you'll be working for free for half a year, but...」

81:t_1:97.en:
$$店長$$
「Never mind that. What was it, space pilot...? Quit chasing flighty dreams and start taking your job seriously already.」

81:t_1:99.en:
$$店長$$
「It's been about half a year since both of us got warped into this world... First we have to make staying alive our top priority.」

81:t_1:100.en:
$$店長$$
「This part-time job is a far cry from being a space pilot, but nowhere else is going to take you in with room and board and staff meals.」

81:t_1:102.en:
$$店長$$
「Besides, the space pilots you long to be might not even exist in this world...」

81:t_1:103.en:
$$店長$$
「And on top of that, this town... no, this whole planet might not see tomorrow.」

81:t_1:108.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What a run-down place.」

81:t_1:109.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「If we'd been posted to $$セントラル・ベース$$, we'd never have had to come to a dump like this.」

81:t_1:112.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「That's right, little miss. We're $$サイデリアル$$... the rulers of this planet.」

81:t_1:113.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We're here to manage the $$レイライン$$ near this town. We'll be imposing on you for a while.」

81:t_1:114.en:
$$店長$$
「Y-yes. Then, to commemorate your first visit, today we'd like to treat you to drinks on the house.」

81:t_1:115.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「That woman over there seems to understand her place.」

81:t_1:117.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, little miss. The only reason $$サイデリアル$$ doesn't govern this town directly is that it's not worth that much.」

81:t_1:118.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Flip that around, and it means nothing matters if a worthless town turns to ash or whatever happens to it.」

81:t_1:120.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Naturally, if this town loses a resident or so, nobody's going to care.」

81:t_1:121.en:
$$店長$$
「I'm terribly sorry, sir...! This girl just doesn't know her manners...!」

81:t_1:122.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You stay out of it.」

81:t_1:123.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「This brat's eyes... I don't like them.」

81:t_1:124.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Earthlings are a strange race. No matter how badly we beat them down, they never stop resisting...」

81:t_1:125.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You wouldn't find a freak race like this if you searched the whole galaxy.」

81:t_1:126.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's you guys that $$ノノ$$ doesn't like! If you think violence gets you whatever you want, you're dead wrong!」

81:t_1:127.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What did you say?」

81:t_1:128.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ knows. The townspeople are sick of you.」

81:t_1:129.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Get out of this shop... out of this town! We have nothing to serve you, not even a drop of water!」

81:t_1:134.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'll be the one taking those guys on.」

81:t_1:135.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What? Some shrimp just showed up.」

81:t_1:136.en:
$$ラルク$$
「As human beings, you're the ones who are small.」

81:t_1:137.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Big talk! You must really want to die!」

81:t_1:138.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「W-wait! What's on her forehead is...」

81:t_2:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

81:t_2:4.en:
$$レイカ$$
「...Pleased to meet you, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. I am $$三条レイカ$$.」

81:t_2:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Captain of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$, Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.」

81:t_2:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our sister ship, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, is handling a diversion in the Pacific, so for now I am serving as commander of $c.」

81:t_2:7.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I've heard of your exploits from $$破嵐$$ as well.」

81:t_2:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All of us have been saved by him many times. Miss $$三条$$... I'll be counting on you as well.」

81:t_2:9.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Please, call me $$レイカ$$. As one who shares your cause, I will also accompany your unit from now on and lend my cooperation.」

81:t_2:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... Sis $$レイカ$$, putting on airs, aren't you...」

81:t_2:11.en:
$$レイカ$$
「A role like this would be impossible for $$ビューティ$$, don't you think?」

81:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Working hard for your beloved Big Bro $$万丈$$, huh.」

81:t_2:13.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's $$万丈$$ for you! To think he had such a beautiful assistant...!」

81:t_2:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$レイカ$$ isn't the only assistant, you know. The other one, Sis $$ビューティ$$, is one seriously busty babe.」

81:t_2:15.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Oh my, $$勝平$$. I'm not any less shapely than $$ビューティ$$, you know.」

81:t_2:18.en:
$$郁絵$$
「President, $$勝平$$, Captain $$ジェフリー$$ is hearing the story on everyone's behalf right now, so you mustn't interrupt.」

81:t_2:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So... where is $$万丈$$ at the moment?」

81:t_2:21.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I apologize. He is currently acting separately from us to take care of a personal matter.」

81:t_2:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Knowing him, we needn't worry.」

81:t_2:23.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$レイカ$$... Do you know anything about $$トップレス$$?」

81:t_2:24.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I've heard they're a special team that specializes in fighting $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

81:t_2:25.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Tch... I thought I'd get to hear a sexy answer from a beautiful woman's mouth...)

81:t_2:26.en:
$$マオ$$
(You... you sink even lower than $$木下$$...)

81:t_2:27.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Their world was also transferred here by a $$時空震動|lc$$, but...」
